lines.1: For the record, we were holding hands.
lines.2: Yoshimi was squeezing mine with all her strength, like she had no intention of ever letting me escape.
lines.3: Well, that settled it. I was staying the night...
lines.5: Even with Yoshimi steamrolling me, part of me was still looking forward to the sleepover.
lines.6: 「Yoshimi, loosen your grip. I am not going anywhere.」
lines.8: The pressure on my hand eased.
lines.9: 「You two are burning up. See ya!」
lines.10: 「Princess, watch where you are going when you ride!」
lines.11: 「...Honestly. She looks so put-together, but she can be dangerously careless.」
lines.14: 「W-why are you crushing my hand again?!」
lines.16: Whenever we got to this room, Yoshimi always locked the door.
lines.17: Then she handed me a bottle of tea and put away the laundry that had been hanging up.
lines.18: After that she shut the window, locked it, and drew the curtains too.
lines.20: 「Why are you unplugging the phone line?」
lines.21: 「And I will turn my phone off... Leo, yours too.」
lines.25: Only after going through all of that did Yoshimi throw herself into my arms.
lines.26: The force of it made me stagger.
